decision.reason: The empty Fixed Asset Card shows basic fields and the Depreciation Book area, but the exact visible/settable fields for HGB and MACHINES are not yet proven. A saved target asset would risk a misleading master-data proof.

visibleEnoughFor: beginner explanation of the empty Fixed Asset Card
preflight discussion before vendor or purchase invoice
notVisibleEnoughFor: claiming HGB is assigned on the asset
claiming MACHINES is assigned on the asset

allowedActions: open Fixed Assets and a new Fixed Asset Card UI-first
use More/Mehr anzeigen on General and Depreciation Book FastTabs
use Personalize or Page Inspection only as diagnosis if fields remain hidden
capture compact evidence of HGB and MACHINES field visibility

proves: FIXEDASSETS-018 evidence is not sufficient for a safe FA-CNC-01 setup fit.
The next safe step is additional card field mapping, not saving the fixed asset.
K30000, purchase invoice, acquisition, depreciation and posting remain locked.
doesNotProve: HGB or MACHINES assigned on a fixed asset
purchase invoice, acquisition, depreciation, FA ledger entries or G/L trace
bookImpact: Chapter 21 should keep the empty-card screenshot as preflight/learning evidence and add that a book-ready fixed-asset master-data screenshot must visibly show FA-CNC-01, CNC Maschine FRA, HGB and MACHINES.
nextStep: FIXEDASSETS-020-FA-CNC-01-CARD-MORE-FIELDS-MAPPING: expand/diagnose card fields without saving and prove whether HGB and MACHINES are visibly reachable.
